reason: Rules the generated NPC conversations and the shop window follow where MeowDB is silent. Until Iteration Three they lived only in code (audit: quests and npcs_shops domains); they are recorded here so the provenance audit sees them. NpcDialogueBuilder reads offer_prompt and default_talk, ShopWindow reads shop_window_title, and NpcDialogueBuilder.validate_rules() fails on a value the code does not implement, so this file cannot drift from the behaviour.

offer_prompt.reason: MeowDB lists a quest's "On accept" lines in order without marking which one asks the question. MisoStory shows them as pages and puts Yes/No under the last one. For most quests the last line is a question (1006: "...want me to train you?"); for 1000 it is the Quest Helper tip and for 1014-1019 it is "talk to me when you're ready for the next question", statements kept as the prompt because writing a question would invent NPC speech. A quest with no On accept text (1002) is offered as a quest card with the system offer_prompt instead (_system.json).

default_talk.reason: MeowDB does not label when each "What X Says" line is shown (docs/canonical/npcs.md, gaps). Quest NPCs with two or more lines say line 0 until every quest they start or end is completed, then the last line, which reads as the after-quest line for Heena, Roger, Maria, Rain and Mai (Sera's "Did you give my mirror to Heena?" and Sen's "What did my sister say?" read as mid-quest lines but follow the same rule; an owner decision could move them). quest_npc may also be "all_lines_in_order". Townsfolk say all their lines as pages; an NPC with no quoted lines says its first speech-bubble line.

quiz.reason: MeowDB pairs no rule with Rain's quizzes: it does not say whether a wrong answer may be retried (1015's text suggests it can) or whether the next quiz follows at once. A wrong answer shows its paired canonical wrong-answer line and ends the chat with the quest still in progress (talk again to retry); after a right answer the next quiz is offered in a new conversation. Recorded only: the code has this one behaviour.

shop_window_title.reason: MeowDB has no shop title. The shop window names the shopkeeper ("Lucy's Shop") with the canonical function title and map under it; {npc} is the canonical NPC name.
